no_voice: Voice is not available for this language on this device. Please read the text.
footer_note: Results are guidance only, decided by fixed rules from official sources. Always confirm timings and location at the office before you go.
footer_sim: Online submission in this demo is a simulation and does not reach any government system.
hero_title: Find the government schemes you may qualify for, without standing in line
hero_sub: Answer a few simple questions. We show schemes that may fit you, the documents you have or still need, and exactly where to go next.
how_1_d: 23 languages, with voice where your device supports it.
how_2_d: Upload a document or answer a few tap-to-choose questions.
how_3_d: Clear results with the source page and a verified badge.
how_4_d: Documents checklist, offices, official link and a printable packet.
feat_1_d: Eligibility is decided only by approved rules from official text. AI never decides.
feat_2_d: Photos are deleted right after reading. Aadhaar numbers are never kept. Nothing is saved unless you agree.
feat_3_d: We never say you qualify. We say what is likely and what to confirm at the office.
feat_4_d: Large buttons, simple words, voice help and a CSC helper mode for those who need assistance.
lang_sub: Tap your language. You can change it any time.
login_sub: Use your phone number. We send a one-time code.
consent_need_find: Finding schemes needs your consent to continue.
consent_privacy_note: You can delete everything at any time using the Delete my data button.
